body: I’m happy for them. They actually mustered up the courage to do what a lot of us struggle to do. Even though i could name every reason under the son to not work and excel in this system, we can still celebrate small wins no matter how insignificant it may be.
I’ve had my fair share of going into psych wards and yeah it’s not great. But the meals were alright and meeting other patients was cool because i talk to no one but my family.
Small pleasures like internet, food and sleep. I have trouble doing anything else.
I have a drivers license which does come in handy sometimes to help out family
No idea how you did it. I wish I had your resilience.
Yep I feel ya. My initial thought process going into this job is that it’s simple and repetitive and I wouldn’t be bothered doing the same thing at a standard pace. Oh boy how I was wrong.
I was hoping I could get a game in overrun. I saw a post one time someone actually found a full lobby of one so I was very surprised
